description: NY State Board of Elections campaign-finance disclosure transactions (headerless CSV, 54 columns). Combined into data.parquet by the admin Data Import tool. Contributions (money given) are schedule 'A'. Only mapped columns are documented; unlisted indices (0-53) are unused/unknown. Code source of truth: src/lib/campaignFinance.ts NY_DISCLOSURE_COLUMNS.
primaryKeyNote: No single primary key; a transaction is identified by filer_id + date + donor + amount.

columns.name: filer_id
columns.description: Committee/filer id — joins to the committee registry (committees.column00).

columns.name: election_year
columns.description: Election year of the filing period.

columns.name: filing_sched_abbrev
columns.description: Transaction schedule. 'A' = the contributions we match donors on.

columns.name: flng_ent_name
columns.description: Org contributor name; empty for individuals (use 25-27).

columns.name: org_amt
columns.description: Transaction amount. Stored as text in the parquet — CAST AS DOUBLE to sum.

scheduleCodes.A: Monetary Contributions/Receipts (the donations matched to contacts)

notes: Import reads with an EXPLICIT 54-VARCHAR-column schema (no auto-sniff) — NYSBOE ships 0-byte period files that break the sniffer.
All record types are imported; filter scheduleCode='A' for contributions when matching donors to contacts.
data.parquet is ~450 MB and gitignored; on Railway it needs a mounted volume at data/campaign_finance/.
